## HealthCheckMiddleware.setDraining() method

Mark the server as draining (graceful shutdown started): /ready flips to 503 so load balancers stop routing new traffic (COR-03 / B-6).

**Signature:**

```typescript
setDraining(draining: boolean): void;
```
